nieuw.titel: Use Power of Darkness for early buffs and extra moves
nieuw.tekst: Under this Renegades draft, use Power of Darkness early to help cast buffs and extra movement spells before advancing into opposing spell range.
nieuw.waarom: He likes its front-loaded play pattern: powering up early helps the wizard get the spells he needs.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that it is easy to dispel and expects it to be less useful as the wizard moves into range around turns two or three.

bronnen.citaat: you try and power yourself up early game

extraCitaten.citaat: front-loaded early game get all your buffs off get all your extra moves up.

nieuw.titel: Use Focus Familiar to extend Cursing Word's reach
nieuw.tekst: Under this draft, consider Focus Familiar to make setting up Cursing Word easier by casting from a point effectively twelve inches closer.
nieuw.waarom: He says the normal twelve-inch range requires moving into position and hoping the opponent remains in range next turn. Focus Familiar eases that setup.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says the target must not already be in combat when the spell is cast, and the spell then needs to remain in play.

bronnen.citaat: you can increase your range effectively by 12 in and cast from that point instead.

nieuw.titel: Consider a Cauldron of Blood for a Death Hag
nieuw.tekst: Under this draft, he rates a Death Hag on a Cauldron of Blood as a very good choice.
nieuw.waarom: He says the Cauldron makes her a seven-wound model with a five-plus ward save, giving her enough protection to feel comfortable taking an Ogre Blade or Executioner's Axe.

bronnen.citaat: she is a very very good choice.

extraCitaten.citaat: So, it makes your hag seven wounds

nieuw.titel: Consider passing on Black Guard at fifteen points
nieuw.tekst: Despite the draft's improvements, he generally would not take Black Guard of Naggarond at fifteen points per model.
nieuw.waarom: He is unwilling to spend that much per model on infantry.

nieuw.titel: Choose Executioners for a Death Star without Witch Elves
nieuw.tekst: If building a Dark Elf Death Star without Witch Elves under this draft, he recommends Har Ganeth Executioners.
nieuw.waarom: He considers them excellent for their points, citing built-in Veteran, rerolls of ones to wound, Strength 6 and Initiative 6.

bronnen.citaat: and not take witch elves, you're going to take executioners.

nieuw.titel: Protect an Executioner Death Star against magic
nieuw.tekst: He would want at least Magic Resistance 2 and another buff before committing to an Executioner Death Star under this draft.
nieuw.waarom: His concern is making a Death Star that does not simply die.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He recently played his Beastmen against a Swordmaster Death Star, which he considers roughly comparable. He saw it lose models in droves despite magical protection against strong casting bonuses.

nieuw.titel: Consider the armour-piercing banner for Witch Elves
nieuw.tekst: Consider giving Witch Elves the banner that makes their attacks AP1, particularly when you are not taking a Cold One Knight block.

nieuw.titel: Screen Witch Elves with five Harpies
nieuw.tekst: Put five Harpies in front of Witch Elves to block the unit off and give it heavy cover against shooting.
nieuw.waarom: He says this effectively reduces shooting damage and that a screen is already desirable to prevent Frenzy baiting.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that some shooting units ignore cover.

nieuw.titel: Always buy full plate and Veteran for Cold One Knights
nieuw.tekst: Under this draft, he treats full plate and Veteran as compulsory upgrades for Cold One Knights, making them thirty-seven points per model.
nieuw.waarom: He particularly values Veteran's built-in reroll for Stupidity as a major improvement to the unit.

bronnen.citaat: they always take full plate and they always take veteran.

nieuw.titel: Usually choose Daemonology for Doomfire Warlocks
nieuw.tekst: Under this draft, he would choose Daemonology for Doomfire Warlocks almost every time. Hope for Steed of Shadows if you do not already have it elsewhere, with The Summoning as a strong signature fallback.
nieuw.waarom: He rates The Summoning highly and likes using Steed of Shadows to let another unit fly.

bronnen.citaat: you take Daemonology almost every single time.

nieuw.titel: Generate Doomfire Warlock spells after your other casters
nieuw.tekst: When you have multiple casters, generate the Doomfire Warlocks' spell last.
nieuw.waarom: He wants full knowledge of the rest of the army's spells before seeing what the Warlocks roll.

bronnen.citaat: If if you've got multiple castings, you roll this as your the last one.

nieuw.titel: Prefer the revised Hydra to a Bloodwrack Shrine
nieuw.tekst: Under this draft, he would pass on the 140-point Bloodwrack Shrine and favour the revised War Hydra when comparing these similarly priced choices.
nieuw.waarom: He considers the Hydra's revisions strong enough to overshadow the other options in this price range.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He still doubts whether the Hydra will see competitive play because opponents are already building to kill its Toughness 5, five-wound profile.

nieuw.titel: Try three Hydras as a screen for Witch Elves
nieuw.tekst: He tentatively suggests taking a High Beastmaster to unlock three War Hydras under this draft and walking them in front of a large Witch Elf unit as a screen.
nieuw.waarom: He suggests having the Hydras absorb shooting and cannonballs while blocking unwanted Frenzy charges. If they reach combat, that is a bonus to this screening plan.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He presents this as an experiment and warns that armies with two Grand Cannons may still keep Hydras out of competitive play.
